question: What was the total revenue per top-level category for delivered orders? Show top-level category name and revenue, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT top.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories sub ON sub.category_id = p.category_id JOIN categories top ON top.category_id = sub.parent_category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY top.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
pred_sql:
SELECT T1.name AS category_name, SUM(T2.quantity * T2.unit_price * (1 - T2.discount)) AS revenue
FROM categories AS T1
JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id
WHERE T2.is_active = 1 AND T2.is_active = 0 AND T2.status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY T1.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC, T1.name ASC;
raw_output:
SELECT T1.name AS category_name, SUM(T2.quantity * T2.unit_price * (1 - T2.discount)) AS revenue
FROM categories AS T1
JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id
WHERE T2.is_active = 1 AND T2.is_active = 0 AND T2.status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY T1.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC, T1.name ASC;

question: What was the year-over-year growth in delivered-order revenue from 2024 to 2025, as a percentage?

question: What is the gross profit (revenue minus product cost) of delivered orders for each brand? Show brand and profit, highest first.

JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories ct ON p.category_id = ct.category_id
GROUP BY c.email, num_subcategories

question: For each country, what is the average order value of delivered orders, including shipping? Show country and average, highest first.
gold_sql: WITH ov AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.shipping_cost + SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY o.order_id) SELECT c.country, AVG(ov.value) AS avg_value FROM ov JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = ov.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY avg_value DESC;

question: What is the best-selling product by units in each top-level category? Show category, product name and units sold.
gold_sql: WITH u AS (SELECT top.name AS category, p.name AS product, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories sub ON sub.category_id = p.category_id JOIN categories top ON top.category_id = sub.parent_category_id GROUP BY p.product_id), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS rk FROM u) SELECT category, product, units FROM r WHERE rk = 1;
pred_sql:
SELECT c.name AS category, p.name AS product_name, SUM(o.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY c.name, p.name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC;
raw_output:
SELECT c.name AS category, p.name AS product_name, SUM(o.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY c.name, p.name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC;

question: Which brands have an average review rating higher than the overall average rating? Show brand and its average.
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.brand HAVING AVG(r.rating) > (SELECT AVG(rating) FROM reviews);

question: What percentage of gold and platinum customers have written at least one review? Show tier and percentage.
